ops.body:
- **T49 [owner] An area card and "What I'm into" name the same categories in different words** (2026-11-19)
  Area: explore. Seen: `sg-card-kinds.png` (the `atlas` journey, `/tend presence`'s lenses): the card's bars read "Green" and "Views" while "What I'm into" heads the same categories "Parks & green spaces" and "Viewpoints & oddities" (`subtypes-what-im-into-parks.png`), and "How the marks work" sends the reader there in the card's words. Two tables name them: `ATLAS_LABEL` (`src/lib/atlas/atlas.ts`) and `CATEGORIES` (`src/lib/discovery/categories.ts`), which also gives the found line's and its announcement's words ("Food & drink"). The lenses' ux-reviewer 1 (medium) and steward 6. Rests on: `docs/research/ui-references.md` section 1.13, H4 ("the same action has the same word and icon on every screen").
  Recommended: the owner's shape: one table for the eight categories' names, read by the card, the tile's spoken name, the explanation and "What I'm into"'s headings, both reading "Green" and "Views & oddities", with a muted line under each heading of "What I'm into" ("Parks, gardens and nature"); the planner's and the kind walk's sentences take each category's noun, so none reads "views & oddities is concentrated". /vision: aligned (Earn: one name for a kind on every screen; words only, no count). Slice-sized, not one commit: it reaches at least fourteen source files (the two tables; `explore/intoPage.ts`, `components/IntoPage.tsx`; the readers of `ATLAS_LABEL`, `components/atlas/KindStrip.tsx`, `components/planner/RouteRows.tsx`, `atlas/waitingPins.ts`, `kindWalk/words.ts`, `walkPlanner/words.ts`, `walkPlanner/service.ts`; the readers of `CATEGORIES`' label, `app/(tabs)/explore.tsx`, `app/walk.tsx`'s found announcement, `explore/explore.ts`'s found line, `explore/useExplore.ts`), past the run's size, and the card's row at 320 px ("Views & oddities", its step word, its dots and "Suggest a walk") must be pictured first.
  Precedent: iOS Settings and Android's notification settings put a plain heading over each group of switches (docs/research/adjacent-apps.md, "Choose what you are shown: a long list of switches", verified); that the heading matches the name the group has on the screen that sends you there is the same job, the matching name inferred, not recorded. Google Maps' Settings put a plain heading over each section (unverified).
  Otherwise: the card's words alone, "What I'm into" as it is.
  Nov 19: the owner's yes, in person, 2026-11-19: "Short card words (Recommended)": the card and "What I'm into" both read "Green" and "Views & oddities", and "What I'm into" keeps a muted line under each heading (for example "Parks, gardens and nature") (decision 0238). Held from `/tend presence` (over the run's size); waits for a build.
Nov 20: the record of that answer is decision 0239 (main took 0238 while the run was open); the owner's Nov 20 answers there do not change it.

**Nov 19-20, `/tend presence --deploy=main`, a whole, uncapped sweep** (opened from `bfb60fdb`, rebased on `1ae353f3`; lenses 0-7 all run; the second of decision 0229's whole sweeps and the first under the expectation lens, decision 0236).
- Lens 0: presence had no line; five drafted (`docs/expectations/presence.md`, proposed), reworded by the steward and answered by the owner in person ("Ratify as drafted", Nov 19; E-presence-1 reworded to keep PC16, Nov 20). E-presence-2 failed at the lens (Overture's parks, trails, memorial sites and cemeteries counted toward storefronts) and is met for the names the repo holds since `tend presence 2`; E-presence-3, 4, 5 met by their tests; E-presence-1 pending, not judged met.
- Lenses: 1, the readers' journeys (`marks`, `grading`, `curiosities`, `subtypes`, `atlas` with `walk`), pictures to the ux-reviewer and the steward; 2-4 read from the code and the specs; 5, the auditor; 6, `check:vision --list` clean; 7, no `[loop]` item of presence's files.
- Shipped: `tend presence 2` Overture's parks, trails, memorial sites and cemeteries count nothing toward storefronts (`PRESENCE_CODE` p11, nothing carried); `3` a presence table cannot change without the code moving (a fingerprint test); `4` "Courthouses and halls" wears a glyph of its own; `5` "How the marks work" no longer says a "?" is on the map; `6` the atlas journey's SG1 check reads the Sights line from the app (it was red on main); `7` `atlas.ts`'s comments name no stale code.
- The review (one round; the auditor, the ux-reviewer and the steward; accepted 9, deferred 4, to the owner 4, all answered, rejected 0): `audit 2` a castle, a manor or a fort from the map is a place to find and a storefront, Overture's historic site a storefront with no mark; `audit 3` a park, a cemetery or a memorial site never helps call a complex shopping (`COMPLEX_CODE` c2); `audit 4` a remembered area from before presence is stale (the pre-presence landing carry was live); `audit 5` a stronger fingerprint; `audit 6` "light a mark … even where its kind reads none"; `audit 8` no resize in the walk journey. The steward's 4 (the card's step word at 320 px) was built and dropped: kept whole, the kinds' names went to "H.", "A."; filed for the owner with both pictures.
- The owner's answers in person (decision 0239): "Short card words", held as T49 (over the run's size); "Monument, counts nothing", then "Enterable counts both"; "A loop note" (Overture's unread names, E-presence-2's open edge); "Never" (a cemetery in a complex's shopping word); 0230's Never line added as 0237.
- Filed besides: lows `[loop]` in "Presence and kinds", "More attractions", "Explore atlas", "Explore subtypes" and the map's section; `[owner]` lows (the map's and the archive's nature reserves, a museum of a town's past, the tile's dots) and the card's row at 320 px (medium); the stale code in `.claude/rules/presence.md` in "Open before the loop"; two DEFERRED items closed (the landing carry, fixed; the Walk-me-back button over What I'm into, gone since 0192).
- E-presence-1 could not be redrafted after it was committed (the store refuses a proposed line's change and its amendment): the run's first record commit carries it as the owner reworded it, rebuilt in the rebase that renumbered 0238 to 0239.
- The balance: outgrowing its base (ten areas rough); no `G` from lens 0 (no line lacking). The area stays `rough`: this sweep found mediums.
- Journeys on the final build: subtypes, marks, grading, curiosities, atlas, launch.
